This notebook contains cleaned excerpts from my original R analysis. The
normalization, clustering and marker-ranking code is retained, with neutral
object names and local file paths. Input data, results, sample information,
feature panels and biological annotations are not included.

The private input is a Seurat object with an RNA assay. Dependencies are Seurat,
sctransform, dplyr, knitr and rmarkdown. The RNA-layer reset follows the Seurat v5
object structure used in the original notebook.

Execution is disabled by default. This edited version has not been rerun with
the unavailable input data. Algorithm settings below are illustrative and need
reassessment for other inputs; they are not recommendations for every dataset.
Any locally generated tables and figures belong in the private output directory.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  eval = isTRUE(params$run_analysis),
  echo = TRUE, results = "hide", fig.keep = "none",
  message = FALSE, warning = FALSE
)
```

```{r libraries-and-input}
# loading libraries
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(sctransform)

set.seed(1234)

colors <- c('#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#279e68', '#d62728', '#aa40fc',
            '#8c564b', '#e377c2', '#b5bd61', '#17becf', '#aec7e8')

if (!file.exists(params$input_rds)) {
  stop("Supply the private Seurat input locally before enabling execution.")
}
cells <- readRDS(params$input_rds)
stopifnot(inherits(cells, "Seurat"), "RNA" %in% Assays(cells))
dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Log normalization

```{r log-normalization}
###Renormalise (log)
DefaultAssay(cells) <- "RNA"
cells[["RNA"]]@layers$scale.data <- NULL
cells[["RNA"]]@layers$data <- NULL

cells <- NormalizeData(cells)
cells <- FindVariableFeatures(cells, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
#all.genes <- rownames(cells)
cells <- ScaleData(cells) #features = all.genes not used
cells <- RunPCA(cells, npcs = 100)
ElbowPlot(cells, n = 50)
DimHeatmap(cells, dims = 10:25, cells = 200, balanced = TRUE)

####PC15
lognorm_pc15 <- cells
lognorm_pc15 <- FindNeighbors(lognorm_pc15, dims = 1:15, verbose = FALSE)
lognorm_pc15 <- FindClusters(lognorm_pc15, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 0.5)
lognorm_pc15 <- RunUMAP(lognorm_pc15, dims = 1:15,
                       min.dist = 0.5, spread = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)
pdf(file.path(params$output_dir, "lognorm_clusters.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
DimPlot(lognorm_pc15, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap", cols = colors, pt.size = 2)
dev.off()
```

## SCTransform and principal-component choices

The original notebook repeated the neighbor, cluster and UMAP steps for several
principal-component choices. Two of those code blocks are retained here without
their study-specific comparisons or conclusions.

```{r sctransform}
###Renormalise (SCT)
DefaultAssay(cells) <- "RNA"
cells[["SCT"]] <- NULL

cells <- SCTransform(cells, conserve.memory = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
cells <- RunPCA(cells, npcs = 100)
ElbowPlot(cells, n = 50)
DimHeatmap(cells, dims = 15:25, cells = 200, balanced = TRUE)

sct_cells <- cells

####PC10
sct_pc10 <- sct_cells
sct_pc10 <- FindNeighbors(sct_pc10, dims = 1:10, verbose = FALSE)
sct_pc10 <- FindClusters(sct_pc10, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 0.5)
sct_pc10 <- RunUMAP(sct_pc10, dims = 1:10, verbose = FALSE)
pdf(file.path(params$output_dir, "sct_pc10_clusters.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
DimPlot(sct_pc10, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap", cols = colors, pt.size = 2)
dev.off()

####PC15
sct_pc15 <- sct_cells
sct_pc15 <- FindNeighbors(sct_pc15, dims = 1:15, verbose = FALSE)
sct_pc15 <- FindClusters(sct_pc15, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 0.5)
sct_pc15 <- RunUMAP(sct_pc15, dims = 1:15,
                   min.dist = 0.5, spread = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)
pdf(file.path(params$output_dir, "sct_pc15_clusters.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
DimPlot(sct_pc15, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap", cols = colors, pt.size = 2)
dev.off()
```

## Exploratory cluster markers

This section retains the marker-ranking and grouped `top_n` idiom from the
original notebook. It shows the code structure only. No marker lists or
cluster identities are supplied, and cluster-wise rankings do not establish
differences between independently sampled experimental groups.

```{r cluster-markers}
##Find markers for clusters
cells <- sct_pc15
DefaultAssay(cells) <- "SCT"
Idents(cells) <- "seurat_clusters"

cluster.markers <- FindAllMarkers(cells, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.table(cluster.markers, file.path(params$output_dir, "cluster_markers.tsv"),
            quote = F, sep = "\t", col.names = T, row.names = T)
cluster.markers <- read.csv(file.path(params$output_dir, "cluster_markers.tsv"),
                            sep = "\t")

cluster.markers <- cluster.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top20

pdf(file.path(params$output_dir, "cluster_marker_heatmap.pdf"), width = 20, height = 12)
DoHeatmap(cells, features = top20$gene)
dev.off()
```
